correctness.rationale: For every 2<=n<b, integrality of digits implies the paired carry identity with denominator D=n^2-1; grade-school bounds give 1<=c_1<=n-1. If c_k=c_{k-1}=0, j=0,1 force D|bc_1 and D|(bc_2-c_1); elementary elimination forces D|c_1^2, impossible because 0<c_1^2<D. Padding classification follows from c_0=0, c_1>0 and no double highest zero. The independent finite checker found 150 valid palintiples among 3,103,793 input strings and confirmed the theorem, as did 117,810 modular checks. Infinite claim rests on proof, not the test ranges.
